subject: Cadet Building Certifier / Engineering Graduate, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Cadet Building Certifier / Engineering Graduate role advertised on SEEK. The ad is written for a recent engineering graduate or someone early in their career who wants a path into building certification.

My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), covering structural principles and construction methods, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, working to Australian Standards in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked the work against them, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, which is the inspection and compliance side of certification.

I have not worked with the National Construction Code yet and my Australian experience is study, so I would be learning the codes and your processes from the start. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to the Sunshine Coast.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the cadet pathway.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.recipient_role: Director and Building Certifier, Project BA
letter.subject: Application for Cadet Building Certifier / Engineering Graduate
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Cadet Building Certifier / Engineering Graduate role advertised on SEEK. The ad is written for a recent engineering graduate or someone early in their career who wants a structured pathway into building certification under senior certifiers, and I'd like to be considered for it.

My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines, completed in 2019, which covered structural principles, construction methods and project delivery. In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, where I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and wrote technical reports, so reading drawings against a standard and documenting the result is familiar work.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, escalated issues that needed corrective action, and kept site reports and progress records. That is the inspection and compliance side of certification, and I liaised daily with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

Where I fall short of the ad: I have not worked with the National Construction Code, and my Australian experience is study rather than work, so I would be learning the codes and your certification processes from the start. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, willing to travel to sites, and open to discussing relocation to the Sunshine Coast.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the cadet pathway and what the first year involves.

checklist: Decide first whether you would move to the Sunshine Coast and change direction into building certification: the letter says you are open to discussing relocation. If not, do not apply.
The ad asks for CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter: have the BSCE and Advanced Diploma transcripts ready to attach with the two PDFs from this record.
Answer the SEEK questions honestly, including the travel-distance question and your licence details.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "SEEK".
notes: Building certification cadetship (a building surveying career, not civil design) for a recent engineering graduate or early-career person; kept as an honest option because the ad names engineering graduates and Marc decides direction. Building-code knowledge is not on record and is disclosed. Interstate: Sunshine Coast relocation is Marc's call. Contact research (29 Sep 2026): the Project BA site could not be opened from this session (proxy refused the host); search summaries name Luke Neller (Director and Building Certifier) and Daniel Eichhorn (Building Certifier) and the office at 4/59 Mary Street, Noosaville, with only info@projectba.com.au published and no statement that it takes applications. SEEK is the only route; the letter is addressed to Luke Neller from the search summary of the About page, which Marc should glance at before submitting.
